hero.intro: A wine bar on the Volkstraat. Bottles chosen because someone here drank them and wanted you to as well - and a kitchen that borrows from wherever the good idea came from.

menu.heading: Food menu

wine.heading: Urban street wine
wine.body: Growers over labels. A lot of it is low-intervention, none of it is on the list to look clever. If you tell us what you normally drink we will find you the next one - that conversation is the whole point of the room.

about.heading: Wine for the people
about.standfirst: Ta-nnin is Tawat’s bar. He came to Belgium from Thailand, spent years in hospitality before wine got hold of him, and opened this room on the Volkstraat six weeks into a pandemic.
about.body1: The wine came from his father-in-law. What started as somebody else’s enthusiasm turned into evening classes, then a sommelier’s qualification, then the highest diploma the WineWise school gives out - which Tawat collected in May 2020, one month before he opened his own doors.
about.body2: Those doors were meant to open in April. The lockdown moved them to June, and by then waiting had stopped making sense: the room was finished, the racks were full, everything was ready to go. So it opened.
about.body3: The name does two things at once. Tannins are the part of a glass of red you feel rather than taste, and Ta-nnin is most of Tawat’s own name. The lower case is deliberate too - it keeps a little of the Thai in a Flemish street.
about.pullQuote: Wine is not only for the elite.
about.body4: That is the whole argument, and the room is built around it. You can sit, but you can just as easily stand at a high table with a glass and no plan. The list runs from things that cost very little to things that cost properly, and nobody is going to make you feel anything about which one you picked. Most of it comes from small growers, a lot of it is low-intervention, and none of it is on the list to look clever.
about.awardsNote: Awarded by Star Wine List, the international guide to wine bars and restaurants.

cellar.intro: Our little wine shop and event space, just across the road from the bar. Bottles to take home, a few bites, and a lot of reasons to stay for one more glass x
cellar.shopBody: Same owner, same taste as Ta-nnin: growers over labels, a lot of it low-intervention. Every week a few bottles get the spotlight - not every bottle makes it home.
cellar.terrace: The terrace opens when the sun does. Pick a bottle, grab some bites, take a barrel.
cellar.hoursNote: Hours can shift around events. Instagram has the week.
cellar.hostBody: We host in the cellar too - up to {guests} guests for now. Tell us what you have in mind.

gift.heading: Give someone a glass, or a few
gift.body: Any amount from 20 euros, with their name and your message on it. We email it to you as a PDF to print, forward or simply show on a phone. Good at {bar} and at {shop} across the road.
gift.previewAlt: The Ta-nnin x CE-LLAR gift voucher
gift.factValid: Valid for 12 months from the day you buy it.
gift.factSplit: Spend it in one go or over several visits; what is left stays on the card.
gift.notePlaceholder: Happy birthday - the first bottle is on me.
gift.emailHint: We send the voucher here. Forward it, or print it and hand it over.
gift.sendToRecipientHint: We email the voucher to them as well, as soon as it is paid for. Leave this off and it is all yours to pass on.
gift.paymentNote: You pay on the next step, right here, with Bancontact, a card, Apple Pay or Google Pay. The voucher arrives by email a minute later.
gift.payNote: Card details go straight to Stripe, our payment provider, and never reach us. The voucher arrives by email a minute later.
